records.description: Development only: exposes the Oxbow settings over ADB broadcasts so they can be driven from a shell instead of the on-screen panel.

records.description: Adds Instagram's native Download item to every post's menu and saves the original photo or video (current carousel slide) to Pictures/Oxbow or Movies/Oxbow.

records.description: Drops sponsored posts, ad/promo and suggested feed units at the JSON-parse layer, catching the ones injected inline into the timeline that URL blocking misses. Gated on the Ads and Suggested toggles.
records.note: Older target declaration; must be ported and tested before any use with 456.0.0.53.78.

records.name: Force SDR display
records.description: Reroutes Instagram's window colour-mode changes so the app can be pinned to SDR, keeping the dark UI's blacks deep instead of the washed-out look HDR forces.
records.note: Older target declaration; must be ported and tested before any use with 456.0.0.53.78.

records.name: Ghost mode
records.description: Optional: watch stories without being listed as a viewer, read DMs without sending read receipts, type without showing "typing...", screenshot disappearing photos and videos without the sender being told. Each is a runtime toggle.
records.note: Older target declaration; must be ported and tested before any use with 456.0.0.53.78.

records.note: Older target declaration; must be ported and tested before any use with 456.0.0.53.78.

records.name: Hide Meta AI

records.note: Older target declaration; must be ported and tested before any use with 456.0.0.53.78.

records.name: Install-packages permission
records.description: Declares REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES so the update dialog can download and install a new release directly instead of opening the browser.
records.note: Older target declaration; must be ported and tested before any use with 456.0.0.53.78.

records.name: Limit feed to following profiles
